title: 情報工学専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Information and Computer Science Major Lab/Exercises A
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the basic mechanisms of microcontrollers and embedded programming. They will also be given opportunities to master knowledge regarding the Internet and security using routers and switches, gain knowledge and skill via investigations and exercises related to IPv4/IPv6, and study how to control networks via packet capture.
advice: This course covers the following topics: 1. Embedded programming with C/C ++ and assembly language. 2. Basics of microcontroller programming: digital I/O, analog digital conversion, pulse width modulation, and dynamic scanning. 3. Information network construction method 4. Analysis of information transmission path by network capturing 5. Implementation of network capture program using C / C ++ NOTE: A review of Programming I, Programming II, Fundamental Computer Architecture, and Information Networks is required.
requiredKnowledge: Students of this course are expected to have the following: 1. C programming skills. 2. Understanding of the differences between IO mapped register and memory mapped register. 3. Knowledge and skill related to the construction of information networks. 4. Knowledge related to information transmissions using packet capturing tools. 5. Understanding of packet capture implementation techniques.

activityGoals.body: Be able to program AVR microcontrollers in C or assembler, make transfers to the AVR microcomputer board, and ch
Be able to test functions of AVR microcontroller such as GPIO, WDT, interrupt, and PWM.
Be able to test multitasking using an AVR microcontroller.
Be able to explain network hierarchical structures.
Be able to understand Internet traffic using packet capture.
Be able to set a personal IP address on a personal computer.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい。     授業明細   回数 学習内容 授業
